leaves.name: fowlerProp27Print
leaves.doc: Fowler (2026), Proposition 2·7, p. 615: for a negative discriminant congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 4 and positive n, h(Δ) ≤ n implies √|Δ| ≤ 2n² exp(21000n²); h(Δ) counts proper fractional ideal classes (p. 613).
leaves.flag: Human read of the publisher PDF: fork issue #14, comment 6973387139; the lattice discriminant, proper ideal class number, and Picard finiteness bridges are proved in Lean.
leaves.source: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on André–Oort for sums of powers in ℂⁿ, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607–641, Proposition 2·7, p. 615; class number on p. 613; manuscript L588–593.
